lines.name: KraftMaid
lines.notes: Classic KraftMaid door set (no Product Line tag on kraftmaid.com); doors offered in Full and Half overlay versions. Species per guidebook: Alder, Cherry, Maple, Hickory, Quartersawn Oak, Oak, EverCore.

lines.name: KraftMaid Vantage
lines.notes: Premium tier: all-plywood box sides and shelves standard, I-beam base construction, solid-wood dovetail drawers on all four corners, full-extension soft-close drawers (90 lb), DuraKraft Plus finish, Whisper Touch hinges w/ SureMount. 2024 guidebook KM-TMVAN0924. 2026Q1 adds Reeded Maple door, Daybreak stain.

lines.name: KraftMaid 200 Professional Series
lines.notes: Tag shown on kraftmaid.com door pages (2025-26); swatches limited to Birch, Laminate, Paint. 5 doors.

lines.name: KraftMaid 400 Designer Series
lines.notes: Tag shown on kraftmaid.com door pages; 40 doors. Several mirror Masterpiece door designs.

lines.name: KraftMaid 600 Luxury Series
lines.notes: Reimagined Schuler line per loweslaunch.kraftmaid.com: frameless launch Aug 2026, framed and inset Oct 2026; walnut in all three constructions. Door slugs carry Framed/Frameless/Inset suffix.
